set.body: Found by S0.7b. Smoother uses math.exp, whose last-place result may differ between x86 and aarch64 JVMs. That puts byte-identical SCORES.json regeneration in CI at risk. Evaluate StrictMath.exp (fdlibm) under DET-5 and the eyesim parity tolerances, and adopt it if the parity fixtures hold.
set.title: Smoother: StrictMath.exp for cross-architecture determinism
